claims.text: Viral cultures if herpes simplex or zoster is suspected and the diagnosis is unclear.
claims.quote: Viral cultures may help if herpes simplex or herpes zoster is suspected and the diagnosis is not clear clinically.

claims.text: Corneal ulcers are cultured by an ophthalmologist.
claims.quote: Corneal ulcers are cultured by an ophthalmologist.

claims.text: Preseptal vs orbital cellulitis is mainly an eye-exam diagnosis; get CT or MRI if findings are equivocal, the exam is difficult (young children) or there is nasal discharge.
claims.quote: If findings are equivocal, if the examination is difficult (as in young children), or if nasal discharge is present (suggesting sinusitis), CT or MRI should be done to exclude orbital cellulitis, tumor, and other causes of orbital inflammation.

claims.text: Reduced eye movement, pain with eye movement, proptosis or reduced acuity: suspect orbital cellulitis and consult ophthalmology.
claims.quote: Suspect orbital cellulitis and consult an ophthalmologist if there is decreased ocular motility, pain with eye movements, proptosis, or decreased visual acuity.
